cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(rack_realtime_parameter_tests LANGUAGES CXX)

enable_testing()
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_executable(realtime_parameter_mailbox_test realtime_parameter_mailbox_test.cpp)
target_compile_features(realtime_parameter_mailbox_test PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(realtime_parameter_mailbox_test PRIVATE ../include)
target_link_libraries(realtime_parameter_mailbox_test PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(realtime_parameter_mailbox_test PRIVATE /W4 /WX)
else()
    target_compile_options(realtime_parameter_mailbox_test PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
endif()
add_test(NAME realtime_parameter_mailbox COMMAND realtime_parameter_mailbox_test)
